author: Retro Game Corps
description:
NetherSX2 Turnip is a new fork of the popular NetherSX2 apps.  It embeds custom Adreno Turnip drivers into the app itself, for improved accuracy and performance on Snapdragon devices like the Retroid Pocket 5/6, Odin 2/3, and AYN Thor handhelds.  In this video we'll take a look at how it performs compared to NetherSX2 Classic (3668).

NetherSX2 Turnip: https://github.com/nckstwrt/NetherSX2-Turnip
NetherSX2 Classic: https://github.com/Trixarian/NetherSX2-classic
NetherSX2 Patch: https://github.com/Trixarian/NetherSX2-patch
ARMSX2: https://armsx2.net/
